LESSON: SIGN READING 1.2.1 FLUENCY

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.2: Sign Reading 1.2.1 Fluency
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 1.2.1 Fluency, part of Strand 1 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three General.

Key inquiry question: How do we show emotions when Sign Reading a story?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign Reading 1.2.1 Fluency together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and Collaboration: The learner displays teamwork as they engage with peers in timed sign reading.

Values:
Unity: Cooperates with other learners by engaging in timed Sign Reading of a text(50 words per minute) displaying the right facial expressions,

emotions and feelings, with peers.

Pertinent Contemporary Issues:

Life Skills: Self-esteem as the learner shows confidence while their Sign Reading competency improves.

7

Links to other Learning Areas:
The learner uses the reading fluency skills to learn similar concept in Kiswahili Language Activities.

Suggested Learning Resources:

Assistive devices fitted with appropriate technology such as Hearing aids and amplifiers, charts showing words with the target letter sounds, sample

talking tree, flash cards showing target letter sound, signed audio-visual recordings, print or digital stories, pocket charts, print and digital flash cards
